Preview: Edited basic.recover.mp

Recover a percentage of your maximum MP.

Illustrative character: Physical Power 100, Mystic Power 80, Movement 5, Jump 2. Formulas retain the edited Basic rules.

MP — Checks the named resource against the displayed numeric threshold. ≥ means at least; ≤ means at most. Percentage thresholds use that character’s maximum resource. The subject identifies whose resource is checked.
MP Recovery — Restore MP based on the recipient’s maximum when this Skill is used. Healing Down reduces recovery. Cannot exceed the maximum or revive a defeated unit. Rounds the resource amount down.
